install: cd wordpress-site && composer install --no-interaction --no-progress && cd ../shoe-shop && npm install --no-audit --no-fund
test: cd wordpress-site && vendor/bin/phpunit && cd ../shoe-shop && npm test
build: cd wordpress-site && php -l wp-content/plugins/ninja-hello/ninja-hello.php && php -l wp-content/plugins/ninja-hello/includes/Greeter.php && php -l wp-content/themes/ninja-theme/functions.php && php -l wp-content/themes/ninja-theme/index.php && php -l preview/bootstrap.php && php -l preview/router.php && php -l preview/wp-config.php && sh -n preview/start.sh && sh -n docker/ninja-bootstrap.sh && cd ../shoe-shop && npm run build
start: cd shoe-shop && npm run build && npx vite preview --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT --strictPort
